data.explanation: This is your official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2023 from the tax office (Finanzamt). Because more wage tax was withheld during the year than the tax actually owed, you are due a refund of €412.00, which will be paid automatically to the account you gave in your tax return — no action is needed for that. If you disagree with how the tax was calculated, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Musterwalde; the app shows the deadline for this. If you let the deadline pass without objecting, the assessment becomes final and can no longer be challenged.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch)
items.action: Review the assessment and, if you disagree with it, submit an objection (Einspruch) to Finanzamt Musterwalde in writing, electronically, or in person for the record
items.consequence: If the deadline passes without an objection, the assessment becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
